title: Chapter 257: Utuk'S Strength
content:
Chapter 257: Utuk'S Strength

Truni Empire.

Queen Anna also paid attention to this battle.

Logically speaking, a small character like Wang Shuo was not qualified to enter her eyes.

However, Wang Shuo killed her clone last time, which made her very angry. That's why she ordered people to pay attention to this kid and eliminate him when the time is right.

On the battlefield, explosions were heard continuously, and the alliance army led by Wang Shuo stood at the back.

These soldiers drawn from various territories were usually pampered and had never seen such a large-scale war.

Only a very few people could keep their faces unchanged.

After the two sides came into close combat, Wang Shuo still kept his troops still.

The lethality of the crossbow battalion and archers reached the maximum at this time.

The catapult had been quietly withdrawn by Li Jianguo, and Wang Shuo asked the alliance army to prepare for battle.

If the enemy broke through the camp, they must also go up.

The battle entered a white-hot stage.

The army of Nanshanji had suffered more than half of its casualties, but it still did not collapse, which made Wang Shuo frown.

At this time, Wang Shuo noticed the opponent's main general, Wutuoke.

He was invincible on the battlefield, like a beast, and no one could stop him.

Wang Shuo thought that it was probably because of his existence that the army of Nanshanji did not collapse!

It seems that the opponent's main general must be defeated.

Wang Shuo immediately ordered Gong Zheng to stop Wutuoke.

After receiving the order, Gong Zheng flew over with a "Taishan Yading".

At the same time, his body was petrified in mid-air.

Even after being petrified, his height was only the same as Wutuoke.

Wang Shuo checked his attributes by the way.

[Wutuke (Nanshanji General)]

[Level: Level 60 (Intermediate General)]

[Attack Power: 2800]

[Defense Power: 800]

[Health Value: 50000]

Seeing this attribute, Wang Shuo was shocked.

With the blessing of the "Brothers United" buff, Gong Zheng's health value soared to 30,000 after he turned on the transformation.

This Wutuk is really fierce!

Fortunately, Gong Zheng also has skills such as "damage rebound" and "life feedback".

Wang Shuo believes that even with Wutuk's 2800 attack power, Gong Zheng can still hold on for a while.

Li Jianguo also received an order at this time.

All bronze crossbow carts are loaded with bronze spears and aimed at Wutuk.

Wana Village now has a total of 100 bronze crossbow carts, and 30 are left in Wana Village to guard against possible enemy situations.

On the battlefield, 70 bronze spears can cause a total of up to 140,000 damage.

Of course, the opponent's defense value and possible defense skills must also be considered, and the actual damage caused must be lower than this.

But even so, Wang Shuo believes that this round of damage will definitely kill this guy in seconds.

But Gong Zheng and him are entangled, which is not conducive to attack.

So, Wang Shuo quickly approached the two.

Finding the right opportunity, he launched the "Iron Chain Binding".

Four thick chains tied Wutu Ke tightly, although he broke free very quickly.

It only took 2 seconds at most to break free, but it was enough.

Gong Zheng and Wang Shuo immediately flew back, and 70 spears gathered at one point. Seeing this formation, the lords watching the battle widened their eyes and held their breath.

Wutu Ke felt the crisis.

He was terrified, and his hands and feet struggled violently. This was the first time he felt the crisis of death.

But there was nothing he could do, because everything was too late!

70 spears gathered together and directly blew his body to pieces.

Wang Shuo breathed a sigh of relief when he saw this scene.

The lords watching the battle around him felt their scalps numb.

If it were them, this Wutu Ke would definitely be like a nightmare.

Powerful!

And invincible!

But, was he killed by Wang Shuo like this now?

They couldn't believe their eyes.
